name: nostr-signer-chatgpt
description: Sign with Alby, nos2x, or a remote signer without exposing an nsec.

interface.shortDescription: Approve Nostr signatures with your own signer.
interface.longDescription: Connect an Alby, nos2x, or compatible NIP-07 browser extension through a loopback-only approval page. A remote NIP-46 signer remains available as an advanced fallback. Review exact events, approve signatures in the signer, and publish only with separate confirmation. Private keys never enter the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a Nostr note for my review.
